Class CompressionStreamCodec

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.codec.transform.compress.CompressionStreamCodec
All Implemented Interfaces:
Codec<byte[]>
Direct Known Subclasses:
DeflateCodec, GzipCodec, Lz4Codec, ZstdCodec
public abstract class CompressionStreamCodec extends Object implements Codec<byte[]>
Base class for stream-based compression transforms, intended for use with Codec.andThen(Codec).

Subclasses supply the compressing and decompressing streams; this class owns the buffering and, critically, the decompression-bomb guard: decode(byte[]) refuses to inflate past the configured maximum decoded size (67108864L bytes by default). encode and decode are final so the guard cannot be bypassed.

Any stream-based compression library can be adapted by overriding the two factory methods, e.g. wrapping zstd or lz4 streams from a third-party dependency.

  • Constructor Details

    • CompressionStreamCodec

      protected CompressionStreamCodec(long maxDecodedSize)
      Creates a codec that refuses to decode payloads expanding beyond the given size.
      Parameters:
      maxDecodedSize - maximum decoded size in bytes; must be positive. The decoded payload is returned in a single array, so a value above Integer.MAX_VALUE - 8 is clamped to that ceiling: past it the codec throws the documented InvalidPayloadException rather than an OutOfMemoryError
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if maxDecodedSize is not positive
